evidence: Both process crash reports extracted from iPad.xcresult contain the same faulting stack.
cause: ObjC completion inherited MainActor isolation but WebRTC invoked it on its signaling thread.
fix: Explicit @Sendable closures for all peer and camera completions; only Sendable continuation results cross back into actor-isolated methods.
additionalFix: Camera capturer creation deferred until explicit enable passes permission and lifecycle checks.
verificationLimit: The original trap did not reproduce under the local macOS toolchain. Resolution is confirmed by final iOS simulator hosted tests with the actual SDK and capture off; physical capture, networks and production deployment remain unverified.

resolution.status: PASS for covered simulator regression paths
resolution.result: Both formerly crashing actual WebRTC SDK hosted tests pass on each platform; 14 total hosted/UI tests per platform, zero failures/skips.
